facets.description: Admin::GroupsController#add_members (line 66) calls params.require(:group_id), but the member route sends the group id as params[:id], so real requests fail with 400
Admin::GroupsController#remove_member (line 85) calls params.require(:group_id), but the member route sends the group id as params[:id], so real requests fail with 400
The .add_members specs (spec lines 94, 103) pass group_id: directly, which hides the mismatch; they need to pass id: instead
The .remove_member specs (spec lines 115, 125) pass group_id: directly, which hides the mismatch; they need to pass id: instead
